arc_unlocks.description: Regular customers begin recognising the store after day 3 (ISSUE-023)
Trade-in intake becomes available once the player has handled the first basic sales loop.
Haggling becomes available after trade-in quotes are established.
Demo station events start the main stretch once the store has repeat traffic.
Store competitions unlock when regular-customer memory has room to matter.
Midnight releases unlock as late-game traffic spikes and special stock pressure.

win_condition.description: Reach day 30 with at least $5000 cash
